2-CURRENT.txt.content:
CURRENT — 2026-07-07 (Claude Code, cloud)

THE MERGE IS DONE. The repo root app is now the combined GrindNotes: Sasha's local
orange design (grouped note Sets, drag between Sets, context menus, prompt dock,
corner Usage/Type rail, collapsible sidebar) + the cloud rebuild's functionality:

- Cursor: full 360° spins on hard flicks (4 verified wrap-arounds in testing), still
  hangs/settles like a heavy pendulum. Knobs in initCursor() in ui.html.
- Cowork removed ENTIRELY: targets Code + Codex, tabs Claude / Codex, no cowork
  icons or styling anywhere.
- Usage window: one card per prompt — title, date small on the right, then
  Usage +Δ% and Context +Δ%. No weekly, no descriptions.
- Delete → notes/.trash (recoverable), server hops ports if 7717 is busy, --lan
  mode for phones, launcher fails loud instead of silent, msedge/chrome app window.
- Same app doubles as the public read-only mirror (GitHub Pages, auto-deployed).

To update the local install (two clicks, no typing): download
https://salinator513.github.io/Notes/Update-GrindNotes.bat and double-click it.
It swaps in the 5 app files, never touches notes/, and relaunches GrindNotes.
Then feel-check the cursor + usage window. Keep the file — double-click it any
time to pull the latest version.
